name: The Keys To The Kingdom
overview: Scripture reveals the significance of the 'keys to the kingdom' as a symbol of divine authority and stewardship, first illustrated in Isaiah through Eliakim, who was entrusted with the key of the house of David to open and shut with sovereign power. This authority is further affirmed in the New Testament where Jesus grants Peter the keys of the kingdom of heaven, empowering him to bind and loose on earth as in heaven. Believers are called to seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, recognizing that the church, founded on the rock of Christ, will triumph over all opposition, underscoring the spiritual authority and responsibility entrusted to God's servants.
